link.note: Baptism, French Church of New York, 5 Jul 1696: 'Jeanne masse fille de Pierre masse et de Elizabet merserau ne le 22e May' (upgraded to confirmed in Round 3). Her marriage to Daniel Lamoureux is probable, strengthened.

summary: John's 8th-great-grandmother; New York-born daughter of Huguenot refugees Pierre Masse and Elizabeth Mersereau.
bio: Born 22 May 1696 and baptized 5 Jul 1696 at the French Church of New York. Wife of Daniel Lamoureux (maiden name from Daniel's private family record, quoted 1919; their son Daniel's 1720 baptism names 'Jeane'). Added as a new ancestor in Round 2.
sources: Registers of the French Church of New York, Collections of the Huguenot Society of America vol. 1 (1886): https://archive.org/details/collectionsofhug01hugu
A. J. Lamoureux, André Lamoureux, the Huguenot Emigrant, and Family (The Lamoureux Record no. 1, 1919): https://archive.org/details/andrlamoureuxh00lamouoft
